{{Quote|A friend of mine, a fellow agent, has been facing a personal crisis. Due to my responsibilities with CorSec, I can not help her the same way you can. Her name is Dathnaeya Loessin. She works at the capital building in Dearic.|[[Agent/Legends|Agent]] [[Taarna]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:FA">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Fellow Agent|Talus}}</ref>}}
The '''Dearic Capitol''' was the main governmental building of the planet [[Talus/Legends|Talus]]. It was located in the city of [[Dearic/Legends|Dearic]] and housed the Talusian government. [[Prime Minister/Legends|Prime Minister]] [[Hagrin Zeed]] and [[Minister of Protocol]] [[Haleen Snowline]] worked there during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG" /> After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], [[Corellian Security Force|CorSec]] [[Agent/Legends|Agent]] [[Dathnaeya Loessin]] was stationed at the Dearic Capitol.<ref name="SWG:FA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Dearic Capitol was a location in the [[2003]] [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']],<ref name="SWG" /> prior to the [[Star Wars video games|game's]] closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
